  • For every 5 upvoats a comment makes, it receives one top comment point. Regardless of the commentator. 1 TCP / 5 CCP; 2 TCP / 10 CCP; so on an so forth.
  • For every 5 downvoats, the comment receives 1 lowest comment point. -1 TCP / -5 CCP...
  • For Submission, it would be same scenario: One top submission point / 5 submission points. 1 TSP / 5 SCP.  

Instead of changing the graphics or the direction of the arrows (which could prove to be more difficult than needed) a possible approach would be to add another counter and separate those comments that are generally agreeable from those that are highly agreeable to those that are generally disagreeable to those that are highly disagreeable.
